prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 84.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 77.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 32.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder), finish layout changes (finish, layout), and adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance.
Sign-in redesigns (sign_in, redesign) consistently underperformed, generating multiple losses and zero winning tests.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and home wait-info updates (home, wait_info) were helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Adoption new screens (adoption, new_screen) yielded multiple winning tests, though overall performance across tests was mixed.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes, redesigns, and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions systematically underestimated the positive gains achieved by winning tests.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: pick_friend_sound_preview_new_screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated sound and voice preview screen right after pet selection so users can hear pet reactions before confirming adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion has high mean time (1017s); adoption new screens have a history of winning tests.

new_pet_sound_preview.headline: Listen to Your Pet
new_pet_sound_preview.body: Preview sound effects and voice clips for your chosen desktop companion.

candidates.title: sign_in_account_restoration_hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit reassurance hint explaining that signing in with your original social/email account restores all previously adopted pets.
candidates.why: Top support issue was 'Pets missing or reset after signing in again' (8 emails). Sign-in hints are proven top performers.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with your existing account automatically restores all saved desktop pets and cloud progress.

candidates.title: waiting_desktop_render_checklist_wait_info
candidates.change: Display a desktop pet render status checklist on the waiting screen while pet assets compile.
candidates.why: Home wait-info updates consistently win; support reported desktop overlay loading failures (3 emails).

waiting.hint: Preparing pet animations and checking screen overlay permissions...

candidates.title: pick_friend_carousel_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection step into a carousel layout with centered pet animation previews.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes median 89s / mean 1017s. Carousel layout simplifies pet choice navigation.

candidates.title: home_intro_visibility_troubleshooter_new_flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive desktop pet visibility test button directly on the home_intro screen to confirm the pet displays properly.
candidates.why: Finish step has the lowest conversion (64.8%), and support logged 3 reports of pets not showing on desktop.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_badge_preview_new_screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated adoption badge preview screen before rendering starts to highlight completion.
candidates.why: Adoption new screens perform well in tests and build user excitement before the wait step.

new_adoption_badge_preview.headline: Adoption Official!
new_adoption_badge_preview.body: Your desktop companion certificate has been issued and stored in your profile.

candidates.title: story_welcome_overview_hint
candidates.change: Add a hint to the welcome story screen clarifying that desktop pets sit on top of open windows without interrupting work.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean time (514s); clear product positioning sets expectations early.

story.hint: Your pet stays on top of your windows while you work, browse, or play.

candidates.title: waiting_desktop_shortcut_wait_info
candidates.change: Show desktop pet controls hotkey hints on the waiting screen while rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Support theme: 'Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet' (3 emails). Wait-info updates drive conversion.

waiting.hint: Quick tip: Right-click your pet on desktop anytime to access controls, talk, or temporarily hide it.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_faq_copy
candidates.change: Revise home_intro headline and body copy to explicitly explain desktop controls and hiding/showing the pet.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 64.8% completion and users report confusion about controlling desktop pets after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click your pet to interact, drag to move it around, or right-click to open settings and controls.

candidates.title: choose_path_mode_clarity_copy
candidates.change: Update choose_path headline and body copy to clearly distinguish between ready-made pets and custom photo generation.
candidates.why: Choose_path mean completion time is 514s; clearer copy helps users pick the right creation path quickly.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Create Your Pet
choose_path.body: Pick an animated companion instantly, or upload photos to generate a unique custom desktop pet.
